gpu_tip: ~31GB total at 128K context — the smallest Ornith 1.5 35B build, and the one that makes a 32GB machine viable at all. Quality drops noticeably at 2-bit; keeping the embedding and output weights at Q8_0 softens that, but prefer Q3_K_XL or IQ3_M whenever the memory is there.
mac_tip: Needs ~31GB — a 32GB MacBook Pro (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max) is right at the limit; a 36GB config is safer.
